baseline.name: Environment setup
baseline.description: Confirm the Qt for HarmonyOS distribution, HarmonyOS SDK and native toolchain, build/package tools and project template are in place and usable.

inventory.name: Migration inventory
inventory.description: Scan sources and build files for the Qt modules, platform-specific code, system APIs and third-party libraries to migrate, each with an acceptance scenario.

contract.name: Migration plan sign-off
contract.description: State the feasibility verdict and freeze the migration plan; removing, degrading or replacing a feature needs your approval.

pilot.name: Pilot verification
pilot.description: Before broad code changes, prove with a minimal project that the app shell, entry point, Qt linkage, packaging and one high-risk point all work.

implementation.name: Feature migration
implementation.description: Migrate features in dependency order: build third-party libraries and the app first, then make small source changes driven by the build results, each with a validation record.

features.name: HarmonyOS features
features.description: Once the app installs and launches, add the HarmonyOS features chosen in the plan (tap-to-transfer, continuation, share); marked not applicable when none were chosen.

diagnostics.name: Build & fix
diagnostics.description: Build, package, install and run the app on a device; each failure is recorded by its first root cause and fixed before retrying.

handoff.name: Acceptance & handoff
handoff.description: Verify every acceptance scenario, check the final package contents and device runs, and write the migration report.
